items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I work down to Jimmy Ryan's quite often, when Roy Eldridge takes off. ... Yeah, I fill in for Roy.

ctx.x: Well Herman, in these last two or three years, then, since then, have you played at all? Do you take any dates?
Oh yes. I work down to Jimmy Ryan's quite often, when Roy Eldridge takes off.
Oh, you fill in for Roy.
